## Traceability

## Integrity review
- [ ] No fabricated experiment or fabricated object-transfer claims
- [ ] Explicit separation of theory, simulation, instrumentation and verified results
- [ ] Calibration and alternative explanations documented (if testing)
- [ ] Structural validator and regression tests pass
- [ ] No secrets, unauthorized PDFs or unreviewed hazardous instructions

**Green CI = valid data structure, not proof of a portal.**
